issues.problem: Current ISO 9308-1 is a low-background-flora E. coli method; ISO explicitly warns that surface-water background growth can make enumeration unreliable. issues.fix: Use ISO 9308-3 for E. coli in these surface-water matrices, retaining ISO 7899-2 for enterococci. Replace the accreditation sentence with “Its ISO/IEC 17025 scope includes E. coli in surface waters by ISO 9308-3 (most probable number), intestinal enterococci by ISO 7899-2 (membrane filtration), and dissolved nutrients.” Change the dossier's measured E. coli units to MPN/100 mL, retaining all numeric results and enterococci CFU units; synchronize F05/F16 and the coastal-stretch brief's pilot units. Explain that 500/200 are study alarm thresholds borrowing the Directive's coastal good-quality numbers, not regulatory single-sample classifications.
